Definition: Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them
BiblicalUsage: Imna or Imnah or Jimnah = "right hand"; n pr m; 1) the 1st born son of Asher; 2) a Levite, descendant of Imnah, who assisted in the reforms of Hezekiah; n patr; 3) descendants of Imnah, son of Asher
